summary: A single suggestion row shown in the address bar's dropdown list, like a bookmark or history match.
description: Plain `.urlbarView-row` divs (role=option) created by UrlbarView.mjs (a JS class, not a custom element) via #createRowContent/#createRowContentForRichSuggestion/etc.; each row represents one full search/suggestion result in the dropdown and can contain an 'urlbar-action' label or button as a sub-element, so result (the row) and action (a piece within it) are related but distinct concepts in this file.
